defect_record.why_unmapped_fields_are_insufficient: after Amendment 001 a case independently carries Product, Measurement, Citation, blocked-path and freshness states; without a frozen primary decision axis per workstream, one case's states from different axes could be aggregated into the same workstream row and its case buckets could be inflated or cross-counted

amendment_scope.existing_r2_harness_and_tests: UNCHANGED / NOT AUTHORIZED TO MODIFY IN THIS CHECKPOINT

r2_accepted_case_state_reference.r2_state_prerequisite_for_r3: R3 must derive workstream case buckets from the accepted multi-axis case state under the mapping frozen by this amendment; this amendment adds no new case-state field and changes no case-state value

workstream_axis_mapping.CASE_STATE_SOURCE: Amendment 001 amended multi-axis case state, per-case fields: PRODUCT_STATUS, PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES, PRODUCT_MULTI_CAUSE, MEASUREMENT_STATUS, CITATION_STATUS, BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS, ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS, RELEVANT_LATER_CHANGE

workstreams.PRIMARY_CASE_ELIGIBILITY_RULE: a case enters CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES only if PRODUCT_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_DEFECT AND 'HISTORY' is present in PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES AND ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT; a historical HISTORY root-cause family entry alone is insufficient
workstreams.FRESHNESS_REQUIREMENT: ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT required for CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES; freshness cannot create a defect
workstreams.BLOCKED_PATH_INTERPRETATION: BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS is never a primary decision axis; it may act only as PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER / LIMITING_EVIDENCE / CONTRADICTING_EVIDENCE for the specific named path
workstreams.WORKSTREAM_SPECIFIC_LIMITING_RULE: historical rewrite signals alone (mt-011 rewrite = CDMA的那; mt-006 rewrite -> OFDM) do not establish a current confirmed case or current readiness; refreshed current-state Product evidence carrying the HISTORY family is required

workstreams.PRIMARY_CASE_ELIGIBILITY_RULE: a case enters CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES only if PRODUCT_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_DEFECT AND 'RETRIEVAL' is present in PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES AND ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT; a historical RETRIEVAL root-cause family entry alone is insufficient
workstreams.FRESHNESS_REQUIREMENT: ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT required for CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES; freshness cannot create a defect
workstreams.BLOCKED_PATH_INTERPRETATION: BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS is never a primary decision axis; it may act only as PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER / LIMITING_EVIDENCE / CONTRADICTING_EVIDENCE for the specific named path
workstreams.WORKSTREAM_SPECIFIC_LIMITING_RULE: historical V4.6 retrieval attribution alone does not establish a current confirmed retrieval case; true retrieval miss must remain distinguished from generation omission, history failure, measurement issue and multi-cause

workstreams.PRIMARY_CASE_ELIGIBILITY_RULE: a case enters CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES only if PRODUCT_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_DEFECT AND 'GENERATION' is present in PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES AND ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT; a historical GENERATION root-cause family entry alone is insufficient
workstreams.FRESHNESS_REQUIREMENT: ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT required for CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES; freshness cannot create a defect
workstreams.BLOCKED_PATH_INTERPRETATION: BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS is never a primary decision axis; it may act only as PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER / LIMITING_EVIDENCE / CONTRADICTING_EVIDENCE for the specific named path
workstreams.WORKSTREAM_SPECIFIC_LIMITING_RULE: GENERATION root-cause family != specific Generation mechanism isolated; V4.8.2 TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS = null and GENERATION_MECHANISM_ISOLATION = NOT_ESTABLISHED must remain limiting evidence; the family may persist while mechanism support stays unestablished

workstreams.PRIMARY_CASE_ELIGIBILITY_RULE: a case enters CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES only if MEASUREMENT_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_MEASUREMENT_DEFECT AND ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT; no Product root-cause filter applies
workstreams.FRESHNESS_REQUIREMENT: ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT required for CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES; freshness cannot create a defect
workstreams.BLOCKED_PATH_INTERPRETATION: BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS is never a primary decision axis; it may act only as PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER / LIMITING_EVIDENCE / CONTRADICTING_EVIDENCE for the specific named path
workstreams.WORKSTREAM_SPECIFIC_LIMITING_RULE: Measurement axis only; a Product defect on the same case must not automatically count the case as Measurement confirmed; a Product root-cause family is never proof of a Measurement defect

workstreams.PRIMARY_CASE_ELIGIBILITY_RULE: a case enters CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES only if CITATION_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CITATION_DEFECT AND ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT; citation-specific mechanical evidence is required
workstreams.FRESHNESS_REQUIREMENT: ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT required for CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES; freshness cannot create a defect
workstreams.BLOCKED_PATH_INTERPRETATION: BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS is never a primary decision axis; it may act only as PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER / LIMITING_EVIDENCE / CONTRADICTING_EVIDENCE for the specific named path
workstreams.WORKSTREAM_SPECIFIC_LIMITING_RULE: Citation axis only; the aggregate citation_coverage < target gap is a quality-gate signal and may create a QUALITY_GATE_LINK, but it never creates a case-level CURRENT_CONFIRMED case; Product state must not be used to populate current-confirmed Citation cases

case_bucket_derivation_rules.derivation_source: only the workstream's PRIMARY_STATUS_FIELD of its PRIMARY_DECISION_AXIS; for PRODUCT-axis workstreams additionally gated by the workstream PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER

CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES.condition: PRIMARY_STATUS_FIELD = workstream PRIMARY_STATUS_CURRENT_VALUE AND (PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER = NOT_APPLICABLE OR PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER present in PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES) AND ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT
forbidden_sources: historical root-cause family presence without PRODUCT_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_DEFECT
aggregate quality-gate gap promoted to a case-level confirmed defect

STALE_OR_HISTORICAL_CASES.condition: PRIMARY_STATUS_FIELD = STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH OR ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS in {PARTIALLY_CURRENT, HISTORICAL_STALE}; for PRODUCT-axis workstreams family relevance is additionally required

RESOLVED_CASES.condition: PRIMARY_STATUS_FIELD = RESOLVED_OR_CLOSED; for PRODUCT-axis workstreams family relevance is additionally required

NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES.condition: PRIMARY_STATUS_FIELD = NOT_ESTABLISHED, or the primary axis explicitly records a no-current-defect observation (WS-12: NO_CURRENT_MEASUREMENT_DEFECT_OBSERVED; WS-13: NO_CURRENT_CITATION_DEFECT_ESTABLISHED); for PRODUCT-axis workstreams family relevance is additionally required
NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES.note: an explicitly observed no-current-defect state is a non-actionable state; it may never be counted in CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES or STALE_OR_HISTORICAL_CASES

case_bucket_derivation_rules.family_relevance_definition: PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER present in the case's PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES within the accepted multi-axis case state; family relevance never substitutes for the CURRENT_CONFIRMED gate
case_bucket_derivation_rules.count_semantics: bucket counts are per-axis case counts; a case may legitimately appear under more than one Product workstream only through the family sets its own PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES mechanically carries

cross_axis_evidence_rule.FORBIDDEN_ROLE: non-primary axes must not directly populate CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES (or any case bucket) of another workstream
cross_axis_evidence_rule.governed_example: md-004 may legitimately be a WS-11 Product/Generation candidate context and a WS-12 Measurement case (independent axes); its Measurement state must never be used to prove WS-11 Product readiness and its Product state must never be used to prove a WS-12 Measurement defect

blocked_path_semantics.scope_rule: a blocked / disproven path acts only on the specific causal / remediation path it names
blocked_path_semantics.non_interference_example: DOCUMENT_IDENTITY blocked must not remove an otherwise valid GENERATION Product state; it blocks only the DOCUMENT_IDENTITY remediation / mechanism path
blocked_path_semantics.bucket_effect: BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS may never remove a case from CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES of a workstream whose primary axis independently establishes it

freshness_semantics.CURRENT: may support current eligibility only if the primary axis independently establishes the defect
freshness_semantics.NOT_ESTABLISHED: may not be upgraded to CURRENT merely because no relevant later change was identified (RELEVANT_LATER_CHANGE = NO does not imply ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT)

multi_cause_semantics.visibility_rule: with PRODUCT_MULTI_CAUSE = YES a case may be visible to more than one Product workstream only if PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES mechanically contains the corresponding families
multi_cause_semantics.forbidden: Measurement / Citation states must never generate Product multi-cause membership

matrix_schema_field_additions.note: prospectively adds the following to the effective workstream-matrix row semantics; original field names remain and their meaning is clarified by this amendment

fields.PRIMARY_DECISION_AXIS: value domain {PRODUCT, MEASUREMENT, CITATION}; the single axis from which this workstream's case buckets are derived; never BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS
fields.PRIMARY_STATUS_FIELD: the case-state status field of the primary axis: PRODUCT -> PRODUCT_STATUS; MEASUREMENT -> MEASUREMENT_STATUS; CITATION -> CITATION_STATUS
fields.PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER: for PRODUCT-axis workstreams the single Product root-cause family gating eligibility; NOT_APPLICABLE for MEASUREMENT / CITATION-axis workstreams
fields.PRIMARY_CASE_ELIGIBILITY_RULE: mechanical rule: PRIMARY_STATUS_FIELD = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_* AND (filter satisfied) AND ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT
fields.SECONDARY_CONTEXT_AXES: non-primary axes retained only under the six allowed evidence roles; they may never populate case buckets
fields.FRESHNESS_REQUIREMENT: ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS = CURRENT required for CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES; freshness cannot create a defect
fields.BLOCKED_PATH_INTERPRETATION: BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS is never a primary decision axis; specific-path governance blocker / limiting / contradicting role only

r3_consistency_requirements.product_workstreams_rule: WS-09 / WS-10 / WS-11 must not use Measurement or Citation status to populate current-confirmed Product cases
r3_consistency_requirements.measurement_workstream_rule: WS-12 must not use Product status to populate current-confirmed Measurement cases
r3_consistency_requirements.citation_workstream_rule: WS-13 must not use the aggregate citation coverage gap or Product state to populate current-confirmed Citation cases
r3_consistency_requirements.family_count_rule: PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILY_COUNTS from R2 are not equivalent to CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASE_COUNTS because many families are historical-only
r3_consistency_requirements.projection_rule: any R3 workstream row must be fully derivable from the accepted multi-axis case state plus this mapping; no other case source is admissible

effective_analysis_design_definition.EFFECTIVE_ANALYSIS_DESIGN: R1 original frozen design + Amendment 001 + Amendment 002
effective_analysis_design_definition.payload_construction: payload = {key: parent_preflight[key] for key in parent_preflight.analysis_design_digest_spec.extracted_keys}; payload['case_classification_schema'] = amendment_001.amended_case_state_schema; payload['effective_analysis_design_additions'] = amendment_001.effective_analysis_design_additions; payload['workstream_axis_mapping'] = amendment_002.workstream_axis_mapping; digest = sha256(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8'))

integrity.PRE_CHANGE_WORKSPACE_MANIFEST_RULE: all regular files; exclude path segments {.git, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache}; exclude suffixes {.pyc, .pyo}; per-file hash = sha256-path-content-v2-canonical-lf (CRLF/CR normalized to LF for text suffixes, raw bytes otherwise); digest = sha256 over sorted '<relpath>\0<filehash>' entries joined by LF, UTF-8
